VerifyCode.picture_code.title: General Alphanumeric CAPTCHA
VerifyCode.picture_code.comment: Recognize CAPTCHA @{picture_pick} in the browser and return the result @{code_result}

browser_obj.title: Browser Object
browser_obj.tip: Browser handle or browser object variable (required, used to locate CAPTCHA element on page)

code_result.title: Recognition Result
code_result.tip: Returns recognized text (string); a list of strings for batch or multiple results

VerifyCode.slider_code.title: General Slider CAPTCHA
VerifyCode.slider_code.comment: On the slider CAPTCHA with background @{picture_pick}, drag slider @{slider_pick} to the specified position, drag distance is @{drag_distance}

browser_obj.title: Browser Object
browser_obj.tip: Browser handle or browser object variable (used to locate slider and background image)

mini_step.title: Fine Adjustment Step (px)
mini_step.tip: Minimum pixel step for fine drag adjustment, integer, unit px

offset.title: Offset (px)
offset.tip: Set offset based on actual situation

drag_distance.title: Move Distance
drag_distance.tip: Returns the calculated drag distance (integer pixels), can be used directly for drag action

VerifyCode.click_code.title: General Click CAPTCHA
VerifyCode.click_code.comment: Click at the corresponding position on the click CAPTCHA with background @{picture_pick}

picture_pick.title: Click Image Object
picture_pick.tip: Background image to recognize; keep as close as possible to the displayed example, avoid extra white or black borders

hint_position.title: Hint Position
hint_position.tip: Position of the hint text relative to the image to recognize; select Top if the hint is above the image

click_positions.title: Click Positions
click_positions.tip: Coordinate position info of elements to click

VerifyCode.ali_slider_code.title: Alibaba Slider CAPTCHA
VerifyCode.ali_slider_code.comment: Recognize Alibaba slider CAPTCHA, based on background image @{background_pic_pick} and hint text @{hint_text_pick}, calculate the distance @{drag_distance} that slider @{slider_pick} needs to move

browser_obj.title: Browser Object
browser_obj.tip: Browser handle or browser object variable (required, used to locate CAPTCHA elements)

background_pic_pick.title: Background Image Object
background_pic_pick.tip: Background image to recognize; keep as close as possible to the displayed example, avoid extra white or black borders

drag_distance.title: Move Distance
drag_distance.tip: Pixel distance from slider to the correct gap in the verification image

VerifyCode.text_click_code.title: General Text Click CAPTCHA
VerifyCode.text_click_code.comment: Recognize text in background image @{picture_pick}, click in sequence, then click confirm button @{confirm_button_pick}, return click positions @{click_positions}

browser_obj.title: Browser Object
browser_obj.tip: Browser handle or browser object variable (required, used to locate CAPTCHA elements)

picture_pick.title: Click Background Image Object
picture_pick.tip: Background image to recognize for clicking

click_positions.title: Click Positions
click_positions.tip: Coordinate position info of text to click

VerifyCode.spatial_reasoning_click_code.title: Spatial Reasoning Click CAPTCHA (Same Object)
VerifyCode.spatial_reasoning_click_code.comment: Recognize objects in background image @{picture_pick} matching spatial reasoning conditions (same shape, color, size, etc.), click in sequence, then click confirm button @{confirm_button_pick}, return click positions @{click_positions}

picture_pick.title: Click Image Object
picture_pick.tip: Background image to recognize for clicking

click_positions.title: Click Positions
click_positions.tip: Coordinate position info of elements to click

VerifyCode.tencent_grid_click_code.title: Tencent Six-Grid CAPTCHA
VerifyCode.tencent_grid_click_code.comment: Recognize Tencent six-grid CAPTCHA, click matching icons in background image @{background_img_obj} based on hint @{prompt_obj}, then click confirm button @{confirm_button_obj}, return click positions @{click_positions}

click_positions.title: Click Positions
click_positions.tip: Coordinate position info of elements to click

VerifyCode.rotate_slider_code.title: General Rotation CAPTCHA
VerifyCode.rotate_slider_code.comment: Recognize rotation CAPTCHA, drag slider @{slider_obj} on slider bar @{slide_bar_obj} to rotate image @{rotate_picture_obj} to the correct angle

browser_obj.title: Browser Object
browser_obj.tip: Browser handle or browser object variable (required, used to locate CAPTCHA elements)

slide_bar_obj.title: Slider Bar Object
slide_bar_obj.tip: Please upload the complete slider bar element (used to calculate draggable distance)

max_rotate_angle.title: Max Rotation Angle
max_rotate_angle.tip: The rotation angle of the image when the slider is dragged to the end

VerifyCode.double_ring_rotate_code.title: General Double Ring Rotation CAPTCHA
VerifyCode.double_ring_rotate_code.comment: Recognize double ring rotation CAPTCHA, drag slider @{slider_obj} on slider bar @{slide_bar_obj} to rotate inner circle image @{inner_circle_image_obj} to align with outer ring image @{out_ring_image_obj}

slide_bar_obj.title: Slider Bar Object
slide_bar_obj.tip: Please upload the complete slider bar element

max_rotate_angle.title: Max Image Rotation Angle
max_rotate_angle.tip: The rotation angle of the inner circle when the slider is dragged to the end

VerifyCode.trajectory_slider_code.title: General Trajectory CAPTCHA
VerifyCode.trajectory_slider_code.comment: Recognize trajectory CAPTCHA for background image @{background_img_obj}, drag slider by simulating human trajectory

VerifyCode.numeric_calculation_code.title: General Numeric Calculation CAPTCHA
VerifyCode.numeric_calculation_code.comment: Recognize the math expression in CAPTCHA image @{captcha_img_obj}, calculation result is @{calculation_result}

VerifyCode.chinese_calculation_code.title: General Chinese Calculation CAPTCHA
VerifyCode.chinese_calculation_code.comment: Recognize the Chinese math expression in CAPTCHA image @{captcha_img_obj}, calculation result is @{calculation_result}
